notes.text: Search: setting "Prefer newer mail" (Normal, Strong, Off) in the NovaBird settings, like on the PC
Vector search: warning if the NovaBird Helper is older than 0.5.0, because phones and PCs in one group then push each other's vectors out
Settings: row for the push notification "Waiting for new emails"; it shows whether it is on and opens Android's switch for it (only you can hide it there, push keeps running)
The settings entry is now called "Phishing and spam protection"
